snippets.code:
# LangChain4j OpenTelemetry Integration

First-class OpenTelemetry instrumentation for LangChain4j.

## Features

- **Tracing**: Root span per AiService invocation with child spans for LLM, tool, and guardrail operations
- **Metrics**: Request count, latency histograms, token usage, error rates, and retry tracking
- **Privacy-First**: Content redaction enabled by default with opt-in capture
- **GenAI Semantic Conventions**: Full compliance with OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions
- **Spring Boot Integration**: Auto-configuration for zero-code setup
- **Performance**: <5% P95 overhead with async export

## Quick Start

### Maven Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>dev.langchain4j</groupId>
    <artifactId>langchain4j-opentelemetry</artifactId>
    <version>${langchain4j.version}</version>
</dependency>
```

### Basic Usage

```java
import dev.langchain4j.opentelemetry.*;
import io.opentelemetry.api.OpenTelemetry;

// Configure OpenTelemetry (uses OTEL_* environment variables)
OpenTelemetry otel = OpenTelemetryConfigurer.configureOpenTelemetry();
Tracer tracer = otel.getTracer("langchain4j");
Meter meter = otel.getMeter("langchain4j");

// Create listeners
OpenTelemetryAiServiceListener aiServiceListener = new OpenTelemetryAiServiceListener(tracer);
OpenTelemetryChatModelListener chatModelListener = new OpenTelemetryChatModelListener(tracer);

// Build AiService with listeners
MyAssistant assistant = AiServices.builder(MyAssistant.class)
    .chatModel(chatModel)
    .registerListener(aiServiceListener)
    .build();

// Build ChatModel with listener
ChatModel model = OpenAiChatModel.builder()
    .apiKey(apiKey)
    .listeners(List.of(chatModelListener))
    .build();
```

### Spring Boot Integration

Add the Spring Boot starter:

```xml
<dependency>
    <groupId>dev.langchain4j</groupId>
    <artifactId>langchain4j-spring-boot-starter-opentelemetry</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

Configure in `application.properties`:

```properties
# Enable/disable OpenTelemetry (default: true)
langchain4j.opentelemetry.enabled=true

# Content capture (default: false for privacy)
langchain4j.opentelemetry.capture-content=false
langchain4j.opentelemetry.content-truncation-length=1000

# Parameter capture for tools (default: false)
langchain4j.opentelemetry.capture-parameters=false
```

### Environment Variables

Configure OpenTelemetry using standard OTEL_* variables:

```bash
export OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=my-langchain4j-app
export OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4317
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=traceidratio
export OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1
```

## Privacy

By default, all content is redacted to protect privacy:
- LLM request/response content NOT captured
- Tool parameters NOT captured
- Guardrail inputs NOT captured

To enable content capture for debugging:

```java
OpenTelemetryChatModelListener listener = 
    new OpenTelemetryChatModelListener(tracer, true, 1000);
```

## Performance

- P95 overhead target: <5%
- Async export via BatchSpanProcessor
- Configurable sampling for high-volume applications

## See Also

- [LangChain4j Observability](https://docs.langchain4j.dev/tutorials/observability)
- [OpenTelemetry GenAI Conventions](https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/gen-ai/)
- [Examples](examples/)
